newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SOCCER-SWEDEN BEAT SCOTLAND 2-1 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SWEDEN BEAT SCOTLAND 2-1 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Sweden beat Scotland 2-1 in their World Cup group four qualifier on Wednesday.

Sweden - 1-Thomas Ravelli, 2-Gary Sundgren, 3-Patrik Andersson, 4-Joachim Bjrklund, 5-Pontus Kamark, 9-Jonas Thern, 7-Per Zetterberg, 6-Stefan Schwarz (15-Hakan Mild, 15), 8-Andreas Andersson, 11-Kennet Andersson, 10-Martin Dahlin.

Scotland 1-Jim Leighton, 3-Tom Boyd, 2-Craig Burley, 4-Colin Calderwood, 5-Colin Hendry, 6-Tosh McKinlay (15-Scott Gemmill 65), 8-Paul Lambert, 10-Gary McAllister, 11-John Collins 7-Kevin Gallacher, 9-Darren Jackson (16-Gordon Durie, 63).
